error_model.logging: Does not log; relies on validation exceptions.
raises: ValueError for missing incident_id, kind, or summary
RuntimeError if used after cleanup via Cleanable.check_cleaned

dependents.notes: Used by IncidentManager and DevOps tooling to report issues.

integration_flow: Create an Incident with severity and summary
Acknowledge or resolve as part of incident management
Inspect details and root_ids for diagnostics

usage_snippets.code:
incident = Incident('I-1', 'graph_dirty', IncidentSeverity.warning, 'Root graph is dirty')
incident.acknowledge()
usage_snippets.title: Create and acknowledge an incident

order_constraints: Clear root_ids and details before nulling scalar fields

lifecycle.construction: Validates identifiers and initializes status to IncidentStatus.open.
lifecycle.ownership: Owns incident metadata and status lifecycle.

non_goals: Does not prescribe incident resolution policies
pitfalls: Mutating returned root_ids or details expecting internal change
responsibilities: Represent DevOps incidents with severity and status

summary.detail: Lightweight incident record with severity, status, and diagnostic metadata for DevOps tooling.
summary.one_liner: Represents a DevOps incident with status and metadata.
